hook: Your washing machine has a secret germ setting.

steps.say: Check the labels. Bedding and towels that take sixty degrees.
Turn the dial to Hygiene or Allergy.
Dry it straight away, and leave the door open.

safety.say: Follow your manual. One product only, never mix cleaners.

result.say: Fresher sheets, and fewer dust mites.
result.headline: Hot-washed fresh
